radius_definition: Maximum vertex distance from placed AABB center, metres; not an ideal sphere.
center_definition: Placed AABB center relative to street_meta.json game_origin; baked into GLB positions.

render_state_notes.source_fact: SKYDOME hash is excluded from ordinary world placement resolution at 0x4457c0; it uses a separate sky pass.
render_state_notes.launcher: scene.js puts sky in the first layer, disables depth test/write and culling, and forces clip z to w*0.99999. Vertex colour and original UVs are preserved; its sky shader multiplies texture RGB by 2*vertex RGB.
render_state_notes.gltf: Opaque, double-sided KHR_materials_unlit materials with embedded PNGs. Depth state is descriptive extras; glTF does not encode it.
render_state_notes.placement: Explicit section 2600 placement is baked once. No rescaling or camera-follow transform is invented.

unknown: Original runtime sky recentering and exact sky-pass shader/blend state.
Pixel parity and in-browser integration; no game runs performed.
